milestone_name: Neural Policy Prototype & Learned Move-Ordering Evaluation
frozen_baseline_control: Janus Classical Baseline C1 (Native N5, UseKiller=true, UseHistory=true, UsePVS=false, UseLMR=true, UseSEEOrdering=false, UseSEEInQuiescence=false)
candidate_engine: Janus Neural N8-A (C1 + MicroPolicyNet learned move ordering, UseNeuralPolicyOrdering=true, MaxPly=0, MinDepth=4, ScoreWeight=50000)

neural_policy_model.training_dataset: Lichess Elite 2020-06 (80,000 unique positions, 1,500 master games, 60k train / 10k val / 10k test)

search_gating_ablation.rationale: Maintains 100% tactical move parity, caps latency overhead at < 1ms per search, and preserves full iterative deepening search depth.

release_decision.category: Category B (Retain as Research Prototype / Experimental Flag)
release_decision.default_configuration: UseNeuralPolicyOrdering=false (Baseline C1 bit-exact parity preserved by default)
